Stress-test the current fantasy visual semantics by rendering the agent-selected alchemist plus summoner pair in a complex photorealistic scene, using the attached portrait only as visible appearance guidance for an original adult fictional woman.

Create a photorealistic fantasy process-documentation photograph of an original adult fictional woman whose visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair are guided by Image 1. In a copper-and-glass heatwork laboratory she regulates flame beneath a connected crucible, retort, condenser, and receiver. Show dark mineral slurry entering the heated crucible and translucent crystalline fluid collecting in the receiver, joined by a visible amber-to-clear transformation gradient through the glass neck; condensate, mineral slag, and a stained work surface record the process. From the same bounded receiver mouth, one separately embodied glass-and-vapor entity emerges into the room, oriented toward her raised directing hand rather than fused to the apparatus. Its arrival casts a contact shadow and pushes loose droplets outward. Preserve the reference-visible facial structure, hairline, dark wavy hair texture, and natural makeup balance. Use a medium-wide three-quarter composition that keeps her hand-to-control contact, the full apparatus chain, both material states, entity-source relation, and residue readable together.

obligation.composition_instruction: Establish a familiar physically coherent scene through clean photographic capture, select exactly one world invariant to fail, and include a clear normal control state against which the violation can be compared. Apply the same measurable offset, delay, dependency, correspondence, or recursion across at least three separated affected surfaces.
